messages:
deploybot: Pinlist flag raised for runtime v3.2.1 -> models: llama3q-quant / gptx-lite. Reason: SDK binding mismatch observed in canary, fallback to v3.1.8 triggered. Details in /deploy/logs/1712443210.

natalie: pinging @kevin - can you summarize what mismatch looked like? :eyes:

kevin: saw a small schema change in the SDK call signature for `forward_kv` that caused the runtime to reject certain quantized kernels. Repro locally with: ```curl -X POST /internal/check -d '{"model":"llama3q-quant","seq":1024}'``` response 400 with "unsupported-kernel-binding"

maria: would this be a soft pin (canary only) or a global pin? we need release notes and customer comms if global.

kevin: deploybot currently added a temporary pin to pinlist for the EU and host pools (canary -> global escalation prevented). It's soft by default but auto-escalates if error rate > 0.5% for 10m.

sre-oncall: what's our rollback trigger? if the pin causes capacity regressions we need a clear escape hatch. Suggest: rollback to v3.1.8 on >1% 5m error rate OR P95 latency increase >200ms for >10m.

maria: Agree with SRE triggers. Also add a release-note bullet "temporary runtime pin for llama3q-quant due to SDK binding mismatch; customers routed to v3.1.8". Devex needs text by EOD.

kevin: patch: short-term shim in SDK that accepts the old binding landed on main, but not yet deployed to hosted. Patch PR: https://git.redwood/pulls/8123 - requires a runtime kernel reload to take effect.

devops-bot: @deploy-team scheduled a maintenance window 23:00-00:30 UTC to deploy the shim to hosted edge pools. If rollback needed, will run rollback playbook RB-17.

natalie: ok. plan: 1) push SDK shim to hosted in the 23:00 window, 2) monitor deploybot metrics for 30m, 3) if error or latency triggers trip, invoke RB-17 and revert pin to v3.1.8, 4) update release notes and send a short customer advisory.

maria: +1. I'll draft release-note blurb now and post for review. Anyone object to that sequence?

kevin: no objections. I'll be on standby for the kernel reload and can flip the pin if needed.

sre-oncall: I'll watch infra dashboards and set alerts for the thresholds. If we hit the rollback criteria, I'll call for the revert and tag the incident.

natalie: thanks team. tagging this thread for post-mortem if we end up rolling back. deploybot: keep the pin TTL at 6h unless auto-escalated. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Pin TTL set to 6h. Auto-escalation threshold: 0.5% error rate over 10m. Scheduled maintenance window created.
